description: Explain conditional auto-renewal checks, cancellation cutoffs, reminders, keep/cancel choices, and Wealth Blueprint closure.

segments.text: Your trial renewal deadline matters only if automatic renewal is enabled in your agreement terms today.
segments.visual_intent: Physical illustrated still of a calendar page showing the cancellation cutoff date with text 'Check Terms' above it.

segments.text: Read your document to find the specific renewal price and exact cancellation cutoff date listed clearly.
segments.visual_intent: Physical illustrated still of a trial agreement card displaying 'Renewal Price' and 'Cutoff Date' fields highlighted.

segments.text: Set an early reminder to decide whether you will keep this service active or cancel it before the deadline arrives.
segments.visual_intent: Physical illustrated still of a calendar page with a marked reminder line preceding the cutoff and text 'Decide Keep/Cancel'.

segments.text: Follow Wealth Blueprint. Build wealth on purpose.
segments.visual_intent: Physical illustrated still of a calendar page with the provider confirmation logo visible and text 'Build Wealth' below it.
